name: push-guard
description: Stops the git and GitHub accidents that are hard to undo, in the main session and every subagent: keys in a commit or push, making a repo public, force-pushing to a protected branch, and deleting remote branches or repos. It says why and how to go on safely.

protectedBranches.title: Protected branches
protectedBranches.description: Comma-separated branch names or globs (release/*) that Claude may never force-push.

protectedRepos.title: Protected repos
protectedRepos.description: Comma-separated owner/name list, or * for all, that Claude may never make public. Other repos need your /push-guard allow public <repo> first.

allowPaths.title: Paths the key scan skips
allowPaths.description: Comma-separated paths or globs (tests/fixtures/**, *.snap) whose fake keys should not stop a commit or push.
